project("lifted-eval")

add_executable(lifted-eval
    "main.cpp"
)

target_link_libraries(lifted-eval PRIVATE eval-suite)

# Suite CSVs are generated by the evaluation targets; paths come from
# EvalHelpers.cmake via cache variables set in each suite's CMakeLists.txt.
# eval-suite already depends on the suite targets, so no add_dependencies needed here.
target_compile_definitions(lifted-eval PRIVATE
    "EVAL_SYNTHETIC_LIBS_DIR=\"${EVAL_SYNTHETIC_LIBS_DIR}\""
    "EVAL_SUITE_SYNTHETIC_CSV=\"${EVAL_SUITE_SYNTHETIC_CSV}\""
    "EVAL_SUITE_TUM_SMALL_PROGRAMS_CSV=\"${EVAL_SUITE_TUM_SMALL_PROGRAMS_CSV}\""
    "EVAL_SUITE_TUM_BASIC_ALGORITHMS_CSV=\"${EVAL_SUITE_TUM_BASIC_ALGORITHMS_CSV}\""
    "EVAL_SUITE_TUM_SIMPLE_HASH_FUNCTIONS_CSV=\"${EVAL_SUITE_TUM_SIMPLE_HASH_FUNCTIONS_CSV}\""
)
